title: Ultimate Computational Limits
summary: A thought experiment mapping mathematical, informational, physical, and engineering dependencies toward theoretical computational limits.
research_question: Which prerequisite models, discoveries, physical constraints, and technological capabilities shape the theoretical limits of computation?

hypotheses.statement: A black-hole-based computational system can be analyzed as a theoretical endpoint under physical information and computation bounds.
assumptions: Physical bounds apply under their stated assumptions.
A controlled information encoding and output mechanism would be required.
